description: The Canton of Vaud provides this spatial heat-supply scenario to support municipal energy planning. It estimates the distribution of thermal demand in 2035 using building-insulation and population assumptions, identifies zones suitable for district heating and cooling, and allocates local renewable resources and waste heat. The source prioritises resources according to their location and temperature level. Coverage is the canton of Vaud, with a Shapefile ordering option and listed WMS layers in the Swiss CH1903+ coordinate system. The page quotes CHF 1 per square kilometre, a CHF 1 minimum, a CHF 3,000 maximum and a CHF 25 order fee. It lists exemptions including schools and research institutes; eligibility was not tested. Provider conditions are linked as DCG 8401. A limitation is that the scenario is non-binding and must be adapted to local buildings and circumstances. It provides scenario inputs for heat-network capacity planning, not measured future demand. Related catalogue records describe Vaud building-energy estimates and district-heating plants. Viageo's public demo label leaves production availability unresolved.
